Frequently Asked Questions

Which locations are covered?

Booking enquiries are accepted from Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram, Faridabad, Sonipat and nearby NCR areas. Confirm availability for your locality and PIN code.

What are the chimney cleaning charges?

Basic cleaning is listed at ₹499 and deep cleaning at ₹999. Confirm the scope of work and final payable amount before service.

What is the technician visit charge?

The listed technician visit charge is ₹149. Any repair, spare part or additional work is separate and should be approved before proceeding.

Can I book microwave service?

Yes. You can request a microwave technician visit listed at ₹149. Repair charges and parts, if needed, are additional after inspection.

How do I book?

Call 9315259342 or use the WhatsApp booking form on this page.
